You normally pay within 30 days of completion, usually through your solicitor or conveyancer. How your Land Transaction Tax adds up Land Transaction Tax is charged on each part of the price that falls in a band, like income tax. The total is rounded down to the pound. England and Northern Ireland have Stamp Duty Land Tax and Scotland has Land and Buildings Transaction Tax instead.
